guide.summary: Council tied slow logon symptoms to excess startup apps rather than disk failure.
guide.chiefVerdict: Disable unused startup entries, reboot once, then measure time-to-desktop again.

councilDiscussion.content: KB/startup-bloat recommends disabling chat and updater launchers before uninstalling anything.
councilDiscussion.headline: Startup playbook

steps.title: Open Startup Apps
steps.instructions: Open Startup Apps settings and disable unused chat clients and auto-updaters that you do not need at logon.

steps.title: Reboot and compare
steps.instructions: Restart Windows once, then re-run the full audit so PatchGuard can compare post-logon load against this baseline.

knowledgeReferences.title: Startup app bloat
knowledgeReferences.usedFor: Slow logon with many auto-start programs
